title: The Worst Actor Ever
description:
An officer observed a male who had a warrant for his arrest. He started running as soon as the officer approached him. Nothing serious was found in his medical examination. He male was charged with trespass, resisting law enforcement and some traffic offenses and was taken into custody for pending warrants.
